Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 2  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made an error in interpreting the WebSurfer's results. Despite multiple search queries being instructed to focus on confirming the cast of "Heading to the Ground" and cross-referencing this with TVXQ members, the Planner prematurely concluded that Shim Chang-min was the actor who starred in the drama, based on incomplete and inaccurate information. The WebSurfer's retrieved data, notably from Wikipedia, included the lead cast (Shim Chang-min, Go Ara, Lee Yoon-ji, and Lee Sang-yoon). However, Shim Chang-min was incorrectly identified as a main cast member of the drama. Jung Yun-ho (also known as U-Know Yunho) is the actual TVXQ member featured in "Heading to the Ground," which the Planner failed to establish through proper cross-verification or disambiguation of the search results. This led to a misidentification of the correct TVXQ member.
